pashto: سلام!
transliteration: salaam!
englishReviewOnly: Hello!

pashto: نن ښه ورځ ده. د جهیل اوبه څنګه دي؟
transliteration: nun kha wraz da. du jaheel oba tsanga dee?
englishReviewOnly: It is a nice day. What is the lake water like?

pashto: دینه دلته ده. هغه په اوبو کې یو کب ویني.
transliteration: deena dulta da. hagha pu obo ke yaw kab weeni.
englishReviewOnly: Deena is here. She sees a fish in the water.

pashto: په اوبو کې یو کب دی. ته څه وینې؟
transliteration: pu obo ke yaw kab dey. ta tsu weeney?
englishReviewOnly: There is a fish in the water. What do you see?

pashto: زه د یوه عجیب کب په لټه کې یم. زه دلته یو کب وینم.
transliteration: za du yuwa ajeeb kab pu lata ke yum. za dulta yaw kab weenum.
englishReviewOnly: I am looking for an unusual fish. I see a fish here.

pashto: نور کلیوال هم دلته دي. موږ په اوبو کې یو کب وینو.
transliteration: nor kiliwaal ham dulta dee. moong pu obo ke yaw kab weeno.
englishReviewOnly: Other villagers are here too. We see a fish in the water.

pashto: راځه، یو ځای اوبو ته وګورو. زه یو کب وینم.
transliteration: raadza, yaw dzay obo ta wugoro. za yaw kab weenum.
englishReviewOnly: Let us look at the water together. I see a fish.

pashto: کلیوال اوبو ته ګوري. هغوی یو کب ویني.
transliteration: kiliwaal obo ta gori. haghoy yaw kab weeni.
englishReviewOnly: The villagers are looking at the water. They see a fish.

pashto: هو، د جهیل اوبه سړې دي.
transliteration: ho, du jaheel oba saṛe dee.
englishReviewOnly: Yes, the lake water is cold.

pashto: زه د جهیل په اړه خبرې کوم.
transliteration: za du jaheel pu ara khabare kawum.
englishReviewOnly: I am talking about the lake.

pashto: راځه، د اوبو تر څنګ لږ کښېنو.
transliteration: raadza, du obo tur tsang lag kheno.
englishReviewOnly: Let us sit beside the water for a little while.

pashto: سلام! بیا ښه راغلاست.
transliteration: salaam! byaa kha raaghlaast.
englishReviewOnly: Hello! Welcome back.

pashto: هو، دینه کب ویني.
transliteration: ho, deena kab weeni.
englishReviewOnly: Yes, Deena sees a fish.

pashto: زه د جهیل په اړه خبرې کوم.
transliteration: za du jaheel pu ara khabare kawum.
englishReviewOnly: I am talking about the lake.

pashto: راځه، کب ته وګورو.
transliteration: raadza, kab ta wugoro.
englishReviewOnly: Let us look at the fish.

pashto: سلام! بیا ښه راغلاست.
transliteration: salaam! byaa kha raaghlaast.
englishReviewOnly: Hello! Welcome back.

pashto: هو، ته کب وینې.
transliteration: ho, ta kab weeney.
englishReviewOnly: Yes, you see a fish.

pashto: زه د جهیل په اړه خبرې کوم.
transliteration: za du jaheel pu ara khabare kawum.
englishReviewOnly: I am talking about the lake.

pashto: کب بېرته اوبو ته لاړ.
transliteration: kab berta obo ta laaṛ.
englishReviewOnly: The fish went back into the water.

pashto: سلام! بیا ښه راغلاست.
transliteration: salaam! byaa kha raaghlaast.
englishReviewOnly: Hello! Welcome back.

pashto: هو، زه کب وینم، خو نه پوهېږم چې هماغه کب دی که نه.
transliteration: ho, za kab weenum, kho na pohegum che hamagha kab dey ka na.
englishReviewOnly: Yes, I see a fish, but I do not know whether it is the same fish.

pashto: زه د جهیل په اړه خبرې کوم.
transliteration: za du jaheel pu ara khabare kawum.
englishReviewOnly: I am talking about the lake.

pashto: د کب راز لا نه دی معلوم.
transliteration: du kab raaz laa na dey maaloom.
englishReviewOnly: The mystery of the fish is still unknown.

pashto: سلام! لټون لا روان دی.
transliteration: salaam! laṭoon laa rawaan dey.
englishReviewOnly: Hello! The search continues.

pashto: هو، موږ کب وینو. د هغه عجیب کب په اړه مو هم خبرې کړې دي.
transliteration: ho, moong kab weeno. du hagha ajeeb kab pu ara mo ham khabare kaṛe dee.
englishReviewOnly: Yes, we see a fish. We have also talked about that unusual fish.

pashto: زه د جهیل په اړه خبرې کوم.
transliteration: za du jaheel pu ara khabare kawum.
englishReviewOnly: I am talking about the lake.

pashto: لا هم نه پوهېږو چې هغه کب چېرته دی.
transliteration: laa ham na pohegu che hagha kab cherta dey.
englishReviewOnly: We still do not know where that fish is.

pashto: سلام! لټون لا روان دی.
transliteration: salaam! laṭoon laa rawaan dey.
englishReviewOnly: Hello! The search continues.

pashto: هو، موږ دواړه کب وینو.
transliteration: ho, moong dwaara kab weeno.
englishReviewOnly: Yes, we both see a fish.

transliteration: za du jaheel pu ara khabare kawum.
englishReviewOnly: I am talking about the lake.

pashto: زه به د هغه عجیب کب لټون ته دوام ورکړم.
transliteration: za ba du hagha ajeeb kab laṭoon ta dawaam warkṛum.
englishReviewOnly: I will continue the search for that unusual fish.

pashto: سلام! لټون لا روان دی.
transliteration: salaam! laṭoon laa rawaan dey.
englishReviewOnly: Hello! The search continues.

transliteration: ho, haghoy kab weeni.
englishReviewOnly: Yes, they see a fish.

englishReviewOnly: I am talking about the lake.
